edge_membership_recovers_triple.admission_note: The constructed hyperedge preserves a three-node membership set without collapsing it to pairwise graph edges.

non_member_excluded_from_triple.exclusion_note: XGI edge membership queries do not admit nodes absent from the constructed hyperedge.

implicit_pair_edge_is_not_created.exclusion_note: Membership inside a 3-node hyperedge is not evidence that the two-node subset was separately constructed as an edge.

singleton_edge_boundary.boundary_note: A singleton hyperedge remains a valid one-node edge and still contributes to the incident node degree.

empty_hypergraph_no_edge_boundary.boundary_note: The no-edge boundary stays empty and does not fabricate incidence records.
